CHECKPOINT: Implementation complete.

Files created/modified:
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch.sh (new, chmod+x): thin dispatcher routing `ticket scratch set/get/clear` to per-verb scripts; unknown verb emits {status:error,code:unknown_verb,verb:<v>} with exit 1
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket (modified): added `scratch` case routing to ticket-scratch.sh via exec; added scratch to _usage help text
- tests/scratch/test-scratch-dispatcher.sh (new, chmod+x): 5 behavioral tests (15 assertions) verifying dispatcher routing for set/get/clear and unknown-verb error envelope

Test results: all 4 scratch test files pass (102 assertions, 0 failures).
Round-trip verified: set writes file, get returns hit, clear removes, get returns miss.
